description: This file defines the ScatterLayout and ScatterPlaneLayout classes, which are custom layout classes for the Kivy framework, providing interactive and transformable layout behaviors based on Scatter widgets.

classes.name: ScatterLayout
classes.description: A custom layout class that behaves like a RelativeLayout but supports translation, rotation, and scaling via Scatter widget functionalities.

classes.name: ScatterPlaneLayout
classes.description: A variant of ScatterLayout based on ScatterPlane, allowing unbounded input interactions.

methods.name: update_size
methods.description: Synchronizes the size of the content layout with the ScatterLayout instance.

methods.name: add_widget
methods.description: Adds a widget to the internal FloatLayout content.

methods.name: remove_widget
methods.description: Removes a widget from the internal FloatLayout content.

methods.name: clear_widgets
methods.description: Clears all widgets from the internal FloatLayout content.

methods.name: collide_point
methods.description: Always returns True, indicating the layout always detects collision at any point.
